shapeSummary: Flat film FSR with thickness 0.254 mm along Y (Y=0 to 0.254). It has a 7.62 mm diameter circular pad at the -X end and a 5.5 mm wide tail strip. Two 1.2 mm wide pin tabs at 2.54 mm spacing extend to x=+17.78. The overall length is 35.56 mm.
warnings: Overall length of 35.56 mm is approximated from the 1.4 in lead spec and is unverified.
Tail width (5.5 mm), pin width (1.2 mm) and pin tab length are estimated from the image.
The active-area ink layer, the green/gray trace layers and the gold crimp terminals are omitted because they are decorative or uncertain.
Thickness is placed along Y to satisfy the bottom-at-Y=0 rule, which differs from the Z-thickness in the image analysis.
The tail is modeled as a straight strip, although the real part appears slightly curved.

L = 35.56
r = 3.81
xc = -L/2 + r

x0, x1 = xc, 14.5
tail = cq.Workplane('XY').box(x1 - x0, t, 5.5, centered=(False, False, True)).translate((x0, 0, 0))
pins = cq.Workplane('XY')
for z in (-1.27, 1.27):

    pins = pins.union(pin)
part = pad.union(tail).union(pins)
